School Run

Haider is holding his oranges 🍊🍊. Yunus snatches them and runs. Who are you?

Tap left/right or swipe to change lanes · P or ⏸ = pause. Swipe up (or ↑ / space) to jump over bags. Desks must be dodged. Yunus: easier run, escape Haider! Haider: hard mode, 60 seconds to catch Yunus or Khan Sir takes him to Bio class. Catch him in time and it’s a FIGHT — Yunus has a SNATCH power that steals oranges (Haider’s health)!
